vertices.title: Where do the evaluation weights come from?
How is a weight change accepted?
vertices.note: Nothing can be merged into the engine until this has an answer, and the answer has to say what evidence a change is judged on. T01 exists to produce that evidence.

vertices.title: What ships in the release binary?
vertices.note: T02 has already measured it. Nobody has written down what the number means.

edges.answer: Hand-tuned, by us. Three strong players on the team and no GPU budget, so the cheap thing is also the only thing.
edges.falsifier: a GPU budget appears, or hand-tuning stalls for two releases running
